behavior.238: RankedFrame.review_state and lease_holder_user_id now come from persisted FrameReview/Lease for the run. Expired-but-unmaterialized open lease is shown as incomplete (saved decision) or unreviewed, with no write on GET. review_state filter is applied in the DB before cursor pagination (no hard-coded unreviewed). Risk/random keep separate ranking entries; frame state is shared per (run, frame) because one FrameReview/lease exists per frame.
behavior.239: GET /api/frames/{id}/issues/ adds snapshot_revision (server-derived from run.snapshot.revision_sha256), annotations[] (every locked-snapshot shape incl. those without candidates: id, source, label_id, bbox, rotation, occluded, outside, z_order, attributes) and predictions[] (immutable CandidateRecord engine output for the frame). Permission/identity/self-review checks unchanged; no auto-confirm.

addProperties.annotations: array of {id:string, source:{kind,id}, label_id:integer, bbox:{x1,y1,x2,y2}|null, rotation:number, occluded:boolean, outside:boolean, z_order:integer, attributes:array}
addProperties.predictions: array of {candidate_id:integer, engine:string, engine_version:string, family:string, anchor:object, evidence:any}
